title: NEW MSFS Marketplace Releases! MC‑21 Pro + WWII C‑47 Liveries Arrive (PC)
description:
This week’s MSFS Marketplace Update for February 14th features a highly anticipated MSFS new aircraft release: the MC-21 Professional by MScenery. If you’re looking for the latest Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 update for PC, we also have a massive drop of MSFS liveries, specifically the C-47 WWII liveries from JED Studio. This MSFS PC marketplace news covers all the latest MSFS add-ons and flight simulator aircraft you need to see.

Whether you're excited for the MC21 MSFS airliner or the historic C47 liveries MSFS pack, this flight simulation news update has you covered.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 MScenery: MC-21 Professional (A modern airliner addition for regional and medium‑range flying)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 JED Studio: WWII D-Days C-47 Liveries (Historic liveries honoring iconic WWII operations)

If you enjoy these weekly updates, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe, and drop a comment letting me know which aircraft or livery you’re picking up!

Thanks for watching and happy flying. ✈️ See you in the skies!
